entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `HostString.FromUriComponent` throws `ArgumentException` for malformed punycode Host values (e.g. `xn--a`) #70066
    Backlog
  • Output caching: a client disconnect on the leading request fails all coalesced requests with 500 #70065
  • Blazor WebAssembly debugging fails after update: “Unable to launch browser: Could not connect to debug target … Socket closed before the connection was established” #70064

Closed

  • Trie routing incorrectly matches endpoints using invariant culture instead of ordinal comparison #70047
    .NET 12 Planning

PullRequests

Created

  • Use JavaNetCookieJar in the SignalR Java client #70067
    area-signalr
  • Fix Blazor activity route correlation for per-page interactivity #70063
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • [StaticAssets] Avoid caching responses for missing manifest assets #70062
    area-blazor

    area-blazor
  • Fix an Issue of dispose a component's JS complement in a Blazor Web App using mixed render modes #70060
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Bound PR review inputs for native readers #70058

    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

    area-commandlinetools, feature-accessibility

    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-middleware
